question: The traditional 'Cheraw' dance, in which bamboo is used, is famous in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mizoram**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** "Cheraw" dance**, also known as the "**Bamboo dance,**" is a captivating performance showcasing the **cultural heritage of the Mizo people of Mizoram**.
 
• It **typically involves six to eight male dancers** **rhythmically clapping bamboo staves** on the ground **while a group of female dancers gracefully perform intricate steps in between the beating bamboo.**
 
• The dance is often performed during festive occasions and holds cultural significance for the Mizo community.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
